name: efc-cmb-localization
title: Systematic Localization of Late-Time Cosmological Signals in Modified Gravity: CMB Survival, the Lensing Barrier, and a Growth-Sector Sign Constraint
description: Five-phase systematic localization study testing EFC against Planck 2018 CMB, DESI 2024 BAO, SDSS DR12 BAO, and Pantheon+ supernovae. Background sector is observationally empty. Perturbation sector survives Planck within a narrow slip window (μ ∈ [0.93, 0.96], Σ ∈ [1.03, 1.07]). The (μ, Σ) valley is degenerate with the A_L anomaly, but fσ₈ data independently confirm μ < 1 at > 2σ.

analysis: Phase 1: Background gate (α–H₀ degeneracy, joint fits)
Phase 2: Perturbation sector (pure μ scan, μ–Σ valley, minimize with free cosmology)
Phase 3: A_L degeneracy diagnostics (χ², Fisher matrix, gradient decomposition)
Phase 4: Growth-sector sign constraint (B0 bridge test with screening filters)

results.background_sector: Observationally empty (α → 0 in all joint fits)
results.growth_sign: μ < 1 at > 2σ from fσ₈ (Δχ² = −5.22 for F3 tanh filter)
results.theory_gap: Grid-AQUAL incompatible: wrong sign, no slip, wrong screening scale
results.status: Localization complete; relativistic perturbation theory required
